negative_reviews.author: CC Chan
negative_reviews.text:
We came here today to celebrate the birthday and were really looking forward to trying the food, but unfortunately, it didn’t live up to our expectations.

Apart from the ramen, the fried chicken and sushi were really disappointing. The fried chicken was cold, tough and very dry. As for the sushi, the photos speak for themselves. The fish on the rainbow rolls was cut thin and small & didn’t taste very fresh. It felt a bit misleading.

The ramen were decent, but the portion was small. I don’t think it would even be enough to satisfy one person. Considering the price £14.9 (not include the 10% service charge), there are plenty of better places offering much better value for money.

Based on our experience, I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant.
